title: I Let the Bike-Pump Gauge Catch the Member Who Returned It at Zero

parts.text: I pulled the floor pump at 6:08 p.m. and the gauge sat at zero with the head still warm. Member Drew was rolling out on full tires. The co-op card said: RETURN WITH AIR. GAUGE READABLE. I was twenty-five, commuter, holding a flat. I photographed the zero, the warm head, and Drew's tires. Drew called it empty luck. Luck is a word gauges use when a warm head exists. I left the still on the tool board Drew checks. Drew fills the pump now. The floor finally looks like air, not a goodbye. I go back to being a person with a receipt.

social.video_title: He returned the pump at zero with a warm head — Part 1/1
social.description: Flat commute, full tires, a tool-board still. Has luck ever been a warm gauge?
